title: MSc Artificial Intelligence
about: Wits University's MSc in Artificial Intelligence, in the Faculty of Science, lists a 30 November closing date on its course finder page. Wits says final admission decisions are made after the closing date, towards the end or start of the academic year.
requirements: Wits cannot give final decisions before the closing date; most schools decide at the end or start of the academic year

upskill.name: AI Foundations Academy
why: Field "Artificial intelligence" (Master's) → AI Foundations objective "Supervised learning: classification, regression, decision trees, SVMs, ensemble methods" (A001.01)
Field "Artificial intelligence" → AI Foundations objective "Transformer architecture (2017): self-attention; backbone of all modern LLMs and vision models" (A001.03)
Record lists no entry requirements and no shortlisted course scored with a genuine match (top scores were AI for Education courses), so the Academy page is used, not a specific course.
